text:
raj.k: Quick heads-up — planning a staging rollout for the new model library next Wed (will flip catalog -> v2). Need final license signoff + perf profiles for the set below. anyone blocked?

sara.l: I can take license checks. list out the exact artifacts please (model + weights + tokenizer).

olivia_p: Model list: ozark-3b-open (weights + tokenizer), cedar7b-quant (4-bit compressed), mariner-13b-v2 (exported hf-snapshot). Also meta: provenance.json + model_card.md for each.

mike_t: perf note: cedar7b-quant needs a perf profile (cpu fallback case) — I have partial traces but not the SLO matrix. assigning to @anya to finalize batching configs.

anya: on it. I ran a quick end-to-end on a 512-token sim and saw cedar7b 4-bit QKV jitter on RTX A100 at 220ms median. will publish perf CSV to the artifacts bucket by EOD.

legal-team: flagged one potential issue: cedar7b-quant includes a small contrib file with an AFL header that might be incompatible with our redistribution policy. can @sara.l or @raj.k confirm whether we need to remove that file from the distributed snapshot?

raj.k: thx — sara, we'd rather avoid removing unless necessary. if AFL only applies to training scripts (not weights) might be OK. can you paste the file path?

legal-team: path is cedar7b/contrib/convert_utils.py — it has AFL-2.1 header and some helper funcs. recommend we vendor a stripped copy or ask upstream for relicensing.

sara.l: I'll open a quick PR to strip the utility and add a NOTICE referencing original. if legal prefers vendor vs remove we'll adapt. target: today.

olivia_p: on the staging rollout checklist: 1) license cleared 2) perf profiles uploaded 3) model_card + manifest present 4) CI dags green 5) smoke canary pass. missing items: license (blocked -> sara), perf CSV (blocking for cedar), manifest for mariner (I don't see model_card.md).

mike_t: CI note — there's an existing flaky test in catalog ingestion (test_manifest_parsing) that sometimes times out for mariner due to large model_card. I added a timeout bump in #8342 but it's still flaky in prod. infra-bot can you re-run the ingestion job after sara's PR?

infra-bot: sched: re-run ingestion job -> job_id: ingest-202-179876. Will retry in 10m.

anya: small FYI on perf CSV format we expect: header must include seq_len, batch_size, median_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, peak_gpu_mem_mb. will use that.

raj.k: pairing checklist: sara -> license PR, anya -> perf CSV, olivia -> model_card for mariner, mike -> CI timeout fix and re-run. target: all done by EOD today so we can cut a staging snapshot tomorrow morning. if anything slips, call it out here.

sara.l: PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/patches/cedar-audit-179876 — stripped contrib, added NOTICE, CC @legal-team.

legal-team: we reviewed the PR, the strip + NOTICE approach is acceptable. marking license: cleared for cedar7b-quant.

olivia_p: uploaded mariner model_card.md -> s3://redwood-artifacts/models/mariner-13b-v2/model_card.md. also added manifest.json with tags and quantization profile.

anya: perf CSV uploaded -> s3://perf-profiles/cedar7b-4bit/cedar7b-4bit-2026-02-14.csv. cedar median now 205ms, p95 410ms on A100. batching recs: prefer batch=4 for <=256 seqs, batch=2 for longer.

mike_t: CI re-run succeeded, ingestion job ingest-202-179876 passed. flaky test fixed with #8343 (timeout bump + better stream parsing).

raj.k: awesome. final ask before staging snapshot: can eng-runtime / serving test a smoke generation with ozark-3b-open and cedar7b-quant using our canary routing policy? @mike_t / @anya please coordinate.

mike_t: I'll run canary ramp at 10qps with fallback to ozark-3b-open. starting in 30m and will post logs.

infra-bot: canary-run started -> run_id: canary-179876-1. watching metrics.

anya: smoke pass results: ozark: 120ms median, cedar fallback (when quant fails) kicked in twice due to mem pressure on one host; logs show ephemeral OOMs on host gpu-12. infra-team, can you investigate host drift?

infra-bot: noted: host gpu-12 flagged as unstable, auto-drain scheduled. will re-place during maintenance window.

raj.k: Thanks team — everything looks unblocked now. I'll schedule the staging snapshot tomorrow AM and send a short launch-readiness note to product + ops. :thumbsup:

sara.l: merging license PR, adding changelog.

olivia_p: pushing final manifests to catalog/v2 and tagging models with "staging-ready".

mike_t: will follow up with latency dashboard after full-day canary.

legal-team: recorded license clearance in the intake tracker.

raj.k: closing loop here — if anything pops up overnight, slack here and I'll re-open the thread. thanks all. :party_parrot:
